author: /root/restart_contact_field
claim: Actual finite-contact valuation inertia in the original full contact field is exactly identity/contact-root flip and has order two

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: A Dedekind order in its exact fraction field, a nonzero prime, and compatible automorphisms are required.
obligations.constructed_input: The whole original SourceOrder is normal by SourceGlobalAffine318, finite over Q[t], Noetherian and dimension at most one. The literal contact polynomial proves ker p nonzero.
obligations.justification: The whole original SourceOrder is normal by SourceGlobalAffine318, finite over Q[t], Noetherian and dimension at most one. The literal contact polynomial proves ker p nonzero.

obligations.name: Actual objects
obligations.required_input: The valuation must be the one attached to the actual source branch prime in the original full field.
obligations.constructed_input: place.asIdeal is definitionally ker p. valuationRing is HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime in SourceFractionField318.L with the original embedding.
obligations.justification: place.asIdeal is definitionally ker p. valuationRing is HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime in SourceFractionField318.L with the original embedding.

obligations.name: Index and domain
obligations.required_input: All four contacts and every original unit twist and specified field-valued branch point must be covered.
obligations.constructed_input: All c,i,p and literal ht are quantified. No fixed twist specialization, chosen named coordinates-only action or rational-point existence assumption is used. Arbitrary-prime reparametrization is not included.
obligations.justification: All c,i,p and literal ht are quantified. No fixed twist specialization, chosen named coordinates-only action or rational-point existence assumption is used. Arbitrary-prime reparametrization is not included.

obligations.name: Local comparison
obligations.required_input: The actual valuation automorphism must agree with the whole original field action everywhere.
obligations.constructed_input: The localization extension agrees on every source element, then localization ringHom_ext proves the ambient square on every valuation-ring element.
obligations.justification: The localization extension agrees on every source element, then localization ringHom_ext proves the ambient square on every valuation-ring element.

obligations.name: Residue identity
obligations.required_input: Inertia requires identity on the complete residue field, not just generators or the original quotient image.
obligations.constructed_input: The exact local residue homomorphism is compared by localization extensionality; residue_surjective proves equality of the entire induced residue automorphism.
obligations.justification: The exact local residue homomorphism is compared by localization extensionality; residue_surjective proves equality of the entire induced residue automorphism.

obligations.name: Full field-group coverage
obligations.required_input: Every actual valuation decomposition element must be covered, not only supplied root signs.
obligations.constructed_input: fieldEquiv is the literal tensor/fraction-field extension, injective, surjective and multiplicative. Every decomposition g is sent to its inverse source automorphism; the built-in action is proved equal to the localized action.
obligations.justification: fieldEquiv is the literal tensor/fraction-field extension, injective, surjective and multiplicative. Every decomposition g is sent to its inverse source automorphism; the built-in action is proved equal to the localized action.

obligations.name: Downstream object and both directions
obligations.required_input: The concluded group must be Mathlib ValuationSubring.inertiaSubgroup on that valuation and field.
obligations.constructed_input: mem_inertia_iff unfolds its actual residue-action kernel. ofOrder proves actual valuation stabilization. inertiaEquiv has both inverse identities. inertia_card and mem_inertia_field_exactly refer to that actual subgroup and original field signs.
obligations.justification: mem_inertia_iff unfolds its actual residue-action kernel. ofOrder proves actual valuation stabilization. inertiaEquiv has both inverse identities. inertia_card and mem_inertia_field_exactly refer to that actual subgroup and original field signs.

obligations.name: Validation
obligations.required_input: Final exact source bytes, predecessor versions and strict evidence must be bound.
obligations.constructed_input: Each module has its own successful strict result or explicit MODULE exit0 marker. One pinned unchanged official source has independent bounded compile evidence. Hosted joined audit and non-author acceptance are pending.
obligations.justification: Each module has its own successful strict result or explicit MODULE exit0 marker. One pinned unchanged official source has independent bounded compile evidence. Hosted joined audit and non-author acceptance are pending.

obligations.name: Conclusion limits
obligations.required_input: Inertia order is not yet a formal ramification-index statement, infinity result or Jacobian identification.
obligations.constructed_input: Those conclusions remain excluded; historical order-prime result is retained separately and consumed by an explicit new comparison.
obligations.justification: Those conclusions remain excluded; historical order-prime result is retained separately and consumed by an explicit new comparison.
